text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic clothing-library product photograph inspired by the described reference, not a copy of a screenshot. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF seamless background, bright soft frontal studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadow, crisp realistic fabric texture, true garment colors, no dramatic shadows. Portrait 2:3 canvas, complete centered objects with generous clear margin. Front-facing straight camera. No people, skin, head, neck, hands, legs, body, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, room, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, borders or collage. ONE isolated accessory product only: One antique silver safety-pin brooch with a short dangling chain, no fabric backing. Large centered catalog object, realistic material texture and precise polished construction. No clothes, no wearing body or mannequin, no outfit, no additional props. A matched pair or integral components of the same product are allowed only when explicitly described.
